Cohort.description: A cohort. Duplicate datasets are refused by the document checks, with their paths.
Cohort.title: Cohort

CohortLeaf.description: Another cohort of the same document (SPEC §7.2).
CohortLeaf.title: CohortLeaf

ExistsLeaf.description: An existence question (SPEC §6.5); ``where`` clauses are ANDed per row of ``table``.
ExistsLeaf.title: ExistsLeaf

IdsLeaf.description: An explicit list of unit keys; not allowed inside any ``where`` (SPEC §7.2).
IdsLeaf.title: IdsLeaf

PackLeaf.description: A pack leaf, ``<pack id>.<name>``: other members are checked by the pack's schema.
PackLeaf.title: PackLeaf

ParameterReference.description: A parameter reference, "$name", or a literal string written "$$…"

ValueLeaf.description: A value predicate (SPEC §6.4): exactly one of ``values``, ``range`` or ``op`` + ``value``.
ValueLeaf.title: ValueLeaf

View.description: A view. Its cohorts and reference are checked by the document checks, with their paths.
View.title: View
